name: Discover it Student Chrome Credit Card

localized_names.en: Discover it Student Chrome Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 6 months on purchases; 16.49% to 25.49% variable APR after that.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not stated on product page (terms_url empty in batch).

credit_required.notes: No credit score required to apply. We may use credit scores if available.

base_rate.description: Unlimited 1% cash back on all other purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem cash back for any amount. Cashback Match: unlimited dollar-for-dollar match of all cash back earned at the end of first year.

signup_bonus.description: Unlimited Cashback Match: Discover automatically matches all the cash back earned from account approval through the first 365 days (effectively 2x first-year cash back); no limit to the match and no purchase minimums.

benefits.title: Unlimited Cashback Match
benefits.description: Get an unlimited dollar-for-dollar match of all the cash back you earn at the end of your first year, automatically. There is no limit to how much we'll match.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability
benefits.description: You're never responsible for unauthorized purchases on your Discover Card.

benefits.title: Build credit with responsible use
benefits.description: Discover reports your credit history to all three major credit bureaus, so your use of the card will appear on your credit report and contribute to your credit score.

notes: Verified against official Discover product page 2026-07-24. APR (16.49%-25.49% variable, 0% intro 6 months) and no-annual-fee confirmed. FX fee not stated on page (terms_url empty). No signup bonus; Cashback Match is first-year promo. 2% cash back at gas stations and restaurants applies to up to $1,000 in combined purchases each quarter (the $1,000 cap is shared across both categories, not per-category), then 1%. Image URL cleared: prior asset was wrong-product card art on a Capital One CDN.
